description: Reviewed Enyo NNUE improvement-run config. Search-aware target-only sparse overfit diagnostic: existing-weight Enyo net, dense frozen, broad loss disabled.
goal: Test whether the search-aware child-margin/policy objective can move target choices at all through exported input/L1 tensors when broad scalar pressure and dense/head updates are removed. Diagnostic only; no SPRT.

required_after_training: training log must show target_top1/top3 or target_sum_gap improvement; otherwise the objective cannot move choices even as an overfit diagnostic
validate.py net-diff against init net must show exported input/L1 movement
static validation is expected to regress; use it only to quantify destructiveness
search-gate only if target metrics move materially; no failure-suite/SPRT from this diagnostic
validation.sprt_rule: Never SPRT this target-only overfit diagnostic. It only answers whether the objective can move target choices through sparse/L1.
